summary: THE REFUTATION HOLDS AND THE PAGES SAY WHERE CH 111 WENT. Standing of the four rows in one breath: ep 54 canon (CONFIRMED AS STORED) but its END is REPAIRED 111 -> 109 with chapters_adapted '109, 111' -> '109'; ep 55 canon (CONFIRMED AS STORED, END 113 [112], chapters string enriched with the page split, no position moved); ep 56 canon (CONFIRMED AS STORED exactly, END 114 [114] {114}); ep 57 canon (CONFIRMED AS STORED) and gains its FIRST anchor, END 112 [111] {111 (pp.6-19), 112 (pp.2-19)} v13, medium, with rearranged{111-112} because it is a back-jump after ep 56's ch 114. EP 54: I read ch 111 '8強の世界 / World of the Quarter-Finals' image by image (20 images: 1 a scanlation credit page, 2-4 the Ojo-vs-Sengoku third-round finish, 5 the four-matchup double spread, 6-19 the body, 20 an Oujou-High omake). Its body — image 6 Kobanzame and two Kyoshin players spying on Deimon practice, 7 the stilt practice, 8-11 Kimidori Sports and Hiruma's part-time job taken FOR spying, 12-13 Sena delivering the astroturf cleats to Kyoshin and being caught ('A SPY!!'), 14 Kakei pinning him one-handed, 15-16 the apology over tea, 17 'IF YOU REALLY HAVE THE SAME AMOUNT OF POWER AS EYESHIELD, TRY AND TAKE ME DOWN! ... Go and tell the fake.', 18 'Is the real Eyeshield still playing at Notre Dame High?' 'NO. HE'S IN JAPAN.', 19 'AND THE MYSTERY OF THE REAL EYESHIELD 21-!!' — is 14 of the chapter's 19 story pages and it is EPISODE 57 on four independent lineages, not ep 54. Nothing of it is in ep 54 on any source: TV Tokyo's own synopsis for 第54話 消えた司令塔 is the Dokubari game start to finish and ends 「ヒル魔ｖｓ金串の頭脳対決が幕をあける！」; en-WP's ep-54 line ends 'The Devil Bats win the game with the help of Hiruma's Devil plans. Hiruma confirms his new slave after the game.'; the 2009 watch-along ends 'Hiruma completely read the opponents play and won the match 42-14. Deimon Devil Bats advance as the best of 8 teams' — which is ch 109's OWN closing line, not ch 111's (ch 109 image 17 is the double spread 'DEIMON'S COMPLETE VICTORY!! DOKUBARI SCORPIONS 0-42 DEIMON DEVILBATS ... Finally at the quarter-finals...!! Now there're 8 teams left'); and the fandom puts 109 on ep 54 in both directions (Episode 54 `chapters = [[109th Down]]`, 109th Down `episode = [[Episode 54]]`). Batch 17's END 111 was an ARC-BOUNDARY pin, and it is refuted on the pages. EP 57: TV Tokyo's 第57話 「21」を知る者 synopsis reproduces ch 111's body beat for beat — 「ヒル魔の差し金により準々決勝の相手・巨深ポセイドンをスパイしに行くはめになるセナとモン太。だが、あっさりと正体がばれポセイドンのメンバーに捕まってしまう」 — and then goes one chapter further: 「彼は自らがアメリカ留学時に出会った完璧なランナーこそがアイシールド21であり」, which is ch 112 image 2's own premise line ('Kakei says that if he hadn't met that guy in America, he probably wouldn't be playing American football now ... that guy is none other than THE REAL EYESHIELD 21!!'), not anything ch 111 states. The watch-along says the same independently: '3 Kyoshin Poseidons went to spy on Deimon Devil Bats ... Himura took a part time job whose main objective is to spy on Kyoshin Poseidons. He sent Sena and Montakun to deliver the goods but they blow their covers ... He explains his previous encounter with the real Eyeshield 21.' So ep 57's END is 112 (A4) and its START is 111 (A13/A10), a back-jump past ep 56's 114 — 'behind is not a basis' (Sean 2026-09-03): a first-time SIGNIFICANT block anchors at its own END with `rearranged`. THE ONE THING I COULD NOT SIZE, stated as a gap: ep 57 closes on an ANIME-ORIGINAL act that exists in no chapter I read (109, 111, 112, 113, 114, 115, 116 all read image by image) — Sena and Monta go back to Kyoshin, Sena challenges Kakei one-on-one, is stopped by Kakei's arm defence, retries and gets past him with the Devil Bat Ghost, and Hiruma, watching, tells him it was not Kakei's true strength (en-WP: 'Sena gets past him using the Devil Bat Ghost, but Hiruma, who had been watching, tells Sena that it was not Kakei's true strength he was running against'; the watch-along adds 'Hiruma who happens to pass by manage to record the incident'). It is NOT a mis-filed ep-60 beat: TV Tokyo's 第60話 synopsis is the IN-GAME duel (「筧は自分とアイシールド21が１対１で勝負することに勝機を見出し」 with the Moby Dick Anchor), a different scene. I type ep 57 canon under T28's faithfulness clause — three of its four acts are ch 111 + ch 112 told in the source's own order, and the invented act dramatises a challenge the source itself issues on ch 111 image 17 — but I have no minute figure for the original act (AFG carries no note or minute range for this series), so the canon/mixed fork is flagged rather than asserted as settled. EPS 55 / 56 confirmed on the pages: ep 55 opens on ch 112's closing pages (images 20-24: Mizumachi's 'since your team has a lot of shrimps ... if you take him out of the team for the next match' and Komusubi bolting) RESTAGED as a chance street meeting — the watch-along is explicit, 'On the way back after the match, Mizumachi and Kakei met Sena, Monta and Komusubi and exchange some words' — and then runs ch 113 whole (the runaway note, the growth-marked tree, the search, Hiruma's 'No use to the team my ass!', Komusubi's return); ep 56 is ch 114 うっちゃれ小結関 end to end (the sumo-club recruitment, the Deimon shopping-street tournament, Otawara, and the chapter's own last beat, Otawara disqualified for not wearing a mawashi — 'Otawaru was later forfeited from the match as he was penalized for nudity'). EP 54's CONTINUE, re-derived under C5 with the covered-or-not test run per chapter: ch 110 IS covered (ep 52, the 109/110 swap the stored `eps 52,54 rearranged{109-110}` annotation already records), ch 111 is NOT covered here and is not animated until ep 57 — so the continue is PARITY at ep 55's START, ch 112, with ch 111 named as the unseen range (the in-series precedent is ep 43 -> 101, where 99-100 were named unseen rather than read early).

anchors.why: A NEW ANCHOR on a row that had none — and it is the home of the chapter ep 54's stored END falsely claimed. START 111 (A13: the row's first chapter; the episode opens on ch 111 image 6, Kyoshin's QB Kobanzame and two team-mates spying on Deimon practice — the watch-along's very first ep-57 beat, '3 Kyoshin Poseidons went to spy on Deimon Devil Bats to report for their team meeting but it didn't work out', and ja-WP's 飯清仁 entry independently records him 「小判鮫と共に泥門に偵察する」). The middle of the episode is ch 111 images 7-19, which TV Tokyo's synopsis reproduces beat for beat: 「ヒル魔の差し金により準々決勝の相手・巨深ポセイドンをスパイしに行くはめになるセナとモン太。だが、あっさりと正体がばれポセイドンのメンバーに捕まってしまう。そんな２人に巨深のキープレーヤーである筧は、スパイされたくらいで負けるわけがない、と言い放つ」. END 112 (A4) rests on the next clause of that same licensor synopsis — 「彼は自らがアメリカ留学時に出会った完璧なランナーこそがアイシールド21であり、泥門にいるアイシールド21は偽者だと言うのだ」 — which is ch 112 image 2's own premise line and NOT anything ch 111 states (ch 111 image 19 only teases it: Mizumachi's 'About Kakei's stay in America ... Ah, d'you wanna know?'). The 2009 watch-along says the same thing independently: 'Kakei reiterated that Eyeshield 21 is a fake. He explains his previous encounter with the real Eyeshield 21' — and ch 112 IS that encounter (Kakei at Phoenix Middle School in the USA, the single play against Notre Dame's Eyeshield 21, 'WHEN WE NEXT MEET IN A MATCH, I WANT TO FACE YOU PROPERLY!' / 'THAT'S A PROMISE!'). Ch 112's own closing pages (images 20-24) are NOT here — they are ep 55's, played two weeks earlier — so ch 112 is split across two episodes in reverse order and a `partial` names it. Ch 111 images 2-5 (the Ojo-vs-Sengoku finish and the bracket splash) are not in ep 57 either; a `partial` names that too. THE ROW IS A BACK-JUMP: ep 56's END is 114, and 'behind is not a basis' (Sean 2026-09-03) — a first-time SIGNIFICANT block anchors at its own END with `rearranged`, which is delivered. WHY MEDIUM, not high: the ch-111 half is four-lineage solid, but the ch-112 half rests on two synopsis-level lineages (the licensor and the watch-along) rather than on a frame-level reading of the episode, and the fandom's per-episode field names only ch 111 (it single-assigns each chapter and puts 112 on ep 55). If Sean prefers the single-lineage-conservative form, END 111 [111] {111 (pp.6-19)} is defensible and costs nothing in coverage, because ep 55's row already carries ch 112 — flagged.

flags_for_sean: THE ONE TYPING FORK I COULD NOT CLOSE — ep 57, canon vs mixed. The episode's closing act is anime-original (Sena returns to Kyoshin, challenges Kakei one-on-one, fails, retries, gets past him with the Devil Bat Ghost; Hiruma, watching and recording, says it was not Kakei's true strength). It exists in no chapter — I read 109, 111, 112, 113, 114, 115 and 116 image by image — and it is not the ep-60 in-game duel (TV Tokyo's 第60話 synopsis is that duel, with the Moby Dick Anchor, and the watch-along has Kakei stopping the Devil Bat Ghost 'for the first time' there, the opposite outcome). I typed the row CANON under T28's faithfulness clause because three of its four acts are ch 111 + ch 112 told in the source's order and the invented act dramatises a challenge ch 111 image 17 itself issues — but I have NO minute figure for it. This series has no sizing instrument at all (AFG prints no note and no minute range for it; AFL has no page), so my weighting rests on beat counts (one of four/five beats on two independent lists) and on the source volume (about 32 story pages, roughly a full episode's worth for this show). If you read that act as a story-carrying half, the row is MIXED and the anchor stands unchanged (a mixed row may carry one).

THE ONE ANCHOR FIELD THAT IS TWO-SOURCE RATHER THAN FOUR — ep 57's END 112. The ch-111 half is solid on four independent lineages. The ch-112 half rests on TV Tokyo's licensor synopsis (「彼は自らがアメリカ留学時に出会った完璧なランナーこそがアイシールド21であり」 — which is ch 112 image 2's own premise line, not anything ch 111 states) plus the 2009 watch-along ('He explains his previous encounter with the real Eyeshield 21'). Both are synopsis-level, not frame-level; the fandom's 2026 field names only ch 111 and single-assigns ch 112 to ep 55. The conservative alternative is END 111 [111] {111 (pp.6-19)}, which costs nothing in coverage because ep 55's row already carries ch 112. I delivered 112 at MEDIUM because A4 asks for the furthest chapter adapted and two independent lineages put ch 112's content in this episode.

AN A10 BOUNDARY CALL ON EP 55's START, ruled rather than assumed. The episode opens on ch 112's closing pages (images 20-24) — exactly 5 book pages, which is A10's '<=5 pages' threshold for a leading partial of the preceding chapter. I KEPT the stored START 112 because the segment is the episode's inciting incident (Mizumachi's taunt is why Komusubi runs away and why the rest of the episode happens), it carries no teaser / cold-open / recap / flashback wording, and both the stored value and the fandom's field say 112. A strict page-count reading would move the START to 113 and leave ch 112 in chapters_adapted under the `partial` annotation already delivered. Either way the END, the volume and the type are unchanged.
